set.sec.title: Manage Security
set.sec.intro: KPI security follows the platform security framework (privilege → duty role → job role → user) managed centrally in the Admin Security Console. Every KPI page and action is registered in the security catalog below; access is currently granted through the KPI job roles, and nothing changes until the enforcement switch is turned on.
set.sec.jobRolesD: Assigned to users in Admin → User Management.
set.sec.dutyRolesD: Bundles of privileges nested inside the job roles (never user-assignable).
set.sec.privilegesD: Verb-first privileges registered for the KPI pages and actions.
set.sec.consoleD: Security is edited in one place only — the Admin app's Security Console. The buttons below open the corresponding console page in a new tab using your current session.
set.sec.registryNote: All KPI-V2 pages, tabs, buttons and endpoints are registered in the security catalog (Security Info drawer), with enforcement kept OFF until the platform flag flips.
